
'''Tajikarao Shrine''' (手力雄神社, also read Tejikarao Shrine) refers to shrines dedicated to {{ill|Ame-no-Tajikarao|ja|天手力雄神・天手力男神}}. Multiple shrines share this name.

* {{ill|Tajikarao Shrine (Tateyama City)|ja|手力雄神社 (館山市)}} (たぢからおじんじゃ) - Located in {{ill|Tateyama, Chiba|en|Tateyama, Chiba|qid=Q646755|lt=Tateyama City}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}.
